description: Adds the person you are helping to the Private SuperIntelligence waitlist. Before calling, show them the exact email, job title and revenue band you will send and get their yes; then set userConfirmed to true. Set dryRun to true to validate without submitting. Qualified registrations ($10 million annual revenue or more) receive a link to book a conversation with Alex Morris.

annualRevenueBand.description: Approximate annual revenue of their organization in USD.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the outcome without submitting anything.

jobTitle.description: Their job title, e.g. "Chief Investment Officer".

userConfirmed.description: True only after the person approved these exact details.
